title: Industry Challenges in Green & Sustainable Chemical Sales

items.title: Long Validation & Testing Cycles
items.html: In many instances, there are validation, testing, and performance periods required to determine the effectiveness of a sustainable chemical, thereby increasing the overall period of sale.

items.title: Multiple Stakeholders in Buying Committees
items.html: From procurement and R&D to ESG teams and regulatory departments, decisions involve cross-functional approval processes.
